value.reply: Here's what's near Springfield for Mia (4) and Leo (1). Swim lessons at the community pool suit Mia, and the library storytime and drop-in playgroup both work for the two of them. What should I call you?
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool for ages 3 to 5, on Saturdays at 10:00. It fits Mia.
Library storytime for all ages on Tuesdays at 10:30, free, and a drop-in playgroup for ages 0 to 6 on weekday mornings, also free. Both work for Mia and Leo.
